NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Health Coach reads your health data (activity, sleep, vitals, nutrition) to show you trends and give you personalised advice. Your data stays on your iPhone.
NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Use Face ID to unlock Health Coach.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Health Coach accesses your photos only to import the reports you choose.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Health Coach uses the camera only to photograph your medical reports.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Health Coach uses the microphone only while you talk to your coach.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Health Coach transcribes your voice so you can talk to your coach. When possible, transcription happens on your phone.
NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Health Coach never writes or changes your data in Health: it only reads it to give you personalised advice.
